hotspots.title: Trump Rally Tour Blitz
hotspots.blurb: President Trump embarked on a multi‑state rally marathon, hitting Alaska, Texas, San Antonio, Nebraska and more, drawing massive crowds and intense media focus as he gears up for the midterms.
hotspots.affect: The nonstop rally schedule fuels outrage, triumph and fear among supporters and opponents, making it the defining story of the window.

hotspots.title: Immigration Enforcement Crackdown
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration announced sweeping actions: suspending tech firms from green‑card programs, planning its own lawyers for migrant children, and seeking to block state aid for undocumented students, sparking heated debate.
hotspots.affect: The moves are portrayed as attacks on immigrants and U.S. jobs, generating alarmist framing and moral panic across outlets.

hotspots.title: Frp Populist Surge & Scandal
hotspots.blurb: Norway’s Progress Party (Frp) hit record poll numbers under Sylvi Listhaug while internal disputes erupted over a NOK 1.7 million payout to party leaders, creating a volatile mix of triumph and controversy.
hotspots.affect: The juxtaposition of soaring popularity and alleged financial impropriety fuels intra‑party outrage and public suspicion.

hotspots.title: Vance Alaska Rally Surge
hotspots.blurb: Vice President JD Vance led high‑energy rallies in Alaska, touring Anchorage and Fairbanks, while Trump also campaigned there, intensifying the GOP push in the state ahead of the midterms.
hotspots.affect: The flurry of appearances underscores a strategic battle for the Alaskan electorate, generating heated local coverage.

hotspots.title: Tech‑Sector Visa Attack
hotspots.blurb: The administration accused Microsoft, Adobe and other tech giants of abusing H‑1B and green‑card programs, suspending their participation and sparking a public feud with the industry.
hotspots.affect: Targeting high‑profile companies frames a narrative of protecting American jobs, provoking sharp backlash and defensive rhetoric from the tech sector.
